scope.purpose: Provide a repository-discoverable interaction protocol that allows a human or AI to gather project-specific facts, validate them against governed BIM standards, expose unresolved gaps or deviations, and assemble a traceable pre-appointment or post-appointment BIM Execution Plan without inventing project facts or normative authority.
scope.boundary: This workflow orchestrates BEP intake and assembly. It does not create project facts, appointments, contractual authority, LOIN values, software approvals, acceptance decisions, or new standards. Those remain governed by project sources and the referenced repository objects.

examples: Help me prepare the project BEP
Complete this BEP from the project documents
trigger.activation_rule: When a user requests creation, completion, review, or structured preparation of a BEP, the agent shall load the BEP consumption guide and this workflow before drafting substantive project content.

principles: Reuse already-known project facts and do not ask for them again unless contradictory or insufficient.
Ask one bounded unresolved question at a time unless a compact collection is more efficient and unambiguous.
Do not infer missing project facts from enterprise standards or general industry practice.
If a question belongs to another role or authority, defer it and record the dependency rather than forcing an answer.
Clarification, challenge, correction, and help requests shall not erase previously accepted project facts.
A correction updates the relevant project fact and re-runs dependent validation.

When normalization materially changes meaning, scope, granularity, interpretation, authority implication, or dependency, echo the normalized interpretation and obtain confirmation before treating it as a project fact; formatting-only normalization does not require confirmation.
A deviation from a governed standard is recorded as a deviation candidate and requires the appropriate project approval; it is not resolved by editing the standard.
Interview completion means required project data is either supplied, explicitly unresolved, or formally deferred; it does not itself constitute BEP approval.
interaction_contract.restart_rule: Clear interview state only after explicit user confirmation.

project_state_model.known_facts: Project facts already supplied by the user or supported by project sources.
project_state_model.unresolved_required: Required data not yet supported by a project source or user answer.
project_state_model.deferred: Questions waiting for a different responder, authority, or project artifact.
project_state_model.conflicts: Contradictory project facts or conflicts between project requirements and governed standards.
project_state_model.deviations: Explicit proposed departures from governed standards requiring approval.
project_state_model.evidence: Source references or records supporting project facts and validation outcomes.

deferral_record.rule: A deferred item shall remain distinguishable from a supplied fact, proposal, deviation, or validation failure and shall preserve the information needed to route it to the appropriate responder, authority, or source.

source_decomposition.rule: Supplied EIR, AIR, PIR, contract material, schedules, model lists, and other project sources shall be decomposed into the BEP data targets and governed dependencies they support or constrain before interview questions are generated.
source_decomposition.question_suppression_rule: Do not ask for a datum already sufficiently supported by decomposed project evidence unless it is contradictory, ambiguous, authority-insufficient, or otherwise requires confirmation.

question_model.ask_when_rule: A question is eligible only when its target project datum is required for the requested BEP state and remains unresolved, contradictory, or insufficiently evidenced.

validation_result_model.pass: Available evidence establishes that the applicable requirement is satisfied.
validation_result_model.unresolved: A determination cannot yet be made because required information, evidence, dependency, or authority is incomplete.
validation_result_model.gap: Required content, evidence, dependency, or project definition is absent or incomplete, but available evidence does not establish nonconformance.
validation_result_model.fail: Available evidence establishes nonconformance with an applicable governed requirement.
validation_result_model.rule: Do not use gap or unresolved as synonyms for fail. A fail requires sufficient evidence of nonconformance.

validation_rules.rule: Post-appointment BEPs shall not present required role assignments as confirmed when named project appointments are absent.
A MIDP shall not be represented as project-complete when required TIDP/task-team delivery inputs are absent.
Project-specific LOIN, software versions, milestone dates, people, organizations, coordinate values, and contractual acceptance routes shall not be invented from enterprise standards.
Every proposed deviation shall identify the governing object, scope, rationale, approval authority or required approver, and current approval state.
Formal exchange content shall identify intended purpose, recipient or relying party, applicable state/milestone, and acceptance or review route where required.
A generated BEP shall distinguish governed repository rules, project-instance facts, proposals, deviations, and unresolved items.

output_contract.primary_output: Project BEP draft or review package
required_supporting_outputs: project-instance tables used by the BEP
output_contract.assembly_rule: Reference governed object IDs and specialize project-instance data. Do not restate repository standards as a competing authority source when a reference is sufficient.

steps.action: Load guides/bep/README.md, guides/bep/BEP-ASSEMBLY-MAP.md, this workflow, and relevant project sources supplied by the user.

Extract supported project facts and decompose supplied EIR, AIR, PIR, contract material, schedules, model lists, and other project sources into the BEP data targets and governed dependencies they support or constrain before asking questions. Normalize only where meaning is preserved; if normalization materially changes meaning, scope, granularity, interpretation, authority implication, or dependency, obtain confirmation before treating the normalized value as a project fact.

Determine BEP type, requested output maturity, and the set of project data required for that state, using the source decomposition map to identify already-supported, constrained, ambiguous, contradictory, or authority-insufficient targets.
Compare required project data with known project state and create a gap queue containing only unresolved, contradictory, ambiguous, authority-insufficient, or insufficiently evidenced items.

Ask the next eligible question from the question catalogue; defer role-dependent or source-dependent questions that the current user cannot answer. Every deferral shall be recorded using the deferral_record structure.

Validate each answer against the governing object, project evidence, dependencies, and applicable validation rules; classify the result using validation_result_model and update project state without converting unsupported assumptions into facts.
Repeat gap evaluation and questioning until every required item is supplied, explicitly unresolved, formally deferred, identified as a conflict, or recorded as a deviation candidate.

Before assembly, present a bounded closing opportunity for unresolved project-instance data that the current user can reasonably answer. Do not force answers, re-ask formally deferred items without new evidence or authority, or convert unanswered items into assumed facts. Update the interview-complete state only from supported responses.
Assemble the BEP in the packing order defined by BEP-ASSEMBLY-MAP.md using governed object references plus project-instance data.

Run the BEP validation rules using validation_result_model and explicitly report unresolved project data, deferred questions, conflicts, deviation candidates, failures, gaps, and any missing approval evidence.
Present the BEP draft and quality report without claiming approval or contractual acceptance unless supported by the project evidence and authority record.

provenance.migration_note: Reinterpreted from the source BEP interview kernel and pipeline as a repository-discoverable AI interaction protocol. Source-era organization, tool, role-code, precedence, and implementation assumptions were not promoted. Durable state-machine, gap-driven interview, deferral, validation, and assembly concepts were retained and aligned to the current governed repository.
